body.statement:
Let \(\mathcal P\) be an input-free COPAG and \(\mathbf M\in\mathfrak M_d^+(\mathcal P)\).  For pairwise disjoint observed sets \(A_0,B_0,C_0,D_0\subseteq V\), if the Rule--2 separation
\[
 A_0\mathrel{\perp_{\mathsf{id}}}I_{B_0}\mid B_0\cup C_0\cup D_0
 \quad\text{in the graph manipulated by }\operatorname{do}(I_{B_0},D_0)
\]
holds, then, pointwise at every positive discrete assignment,
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 &P_{\mathbf M}(A_0=a_0\mid C_0=c_0,
       \operatorname{do}(B_0=b_0,D_0=d_0),S=\mathbf 1)\\
 &\qquad =P_{\mathbf M}(A_0=a_0\mid B_0=b_0,C_0=c_0,
       \operatorname{do}(D_0=d_0),S=\mathbf 1).
 \end{aligned}
\]
